typography.heading_strategy: Industrial and highly legible. Use Barlow for high-impact labels. Web UI uses IBM Plex Sans.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Use sharp, small shadows for interactive elements. shadow-sm on cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E4E4E7 for UI. For print, use strict 2px solid #000000 borders.
visual_enhancers.radii: Subtle roundness for UI: rounded-md (6px). For print, NO border radius (0px) to prevent thermal bleeding on corners.

grids_and_layouts.page_layout: Split-pane Command Dashboard. Left pane (60%) for Forms and Queue table. Right pane (40%) for Sticky Live Preview.
grids_and_layouts.form_grid: Bento High Density Mode. 2-column grid (grid-cols-2) with gap-4 for dense data entry.
grids_and_layouts.print_layout: Flexbox/Grid hybrid. Top bar flex-between. Main product centered. 2-column grid for dates. Stacked flex for minor details.

thermal_fixes: No grayscale, opacity, or rgba colors. Use only pure #000000 and #FFFFFF.
Disable anti-aliasing in @media print: -webkit-font-smoothing: none; font-smoothing: never;
Use extremely bold font weights (700, 800, 900) for all text to prevent thermal fading.
Ensure all borders are at least 2px thick.
Remove all box-shadows and border-radius in print.

layout_hierarchy.dates: PRODUÇÃO and VALIDADE side-by-side. VALIDADE is inverted (white text on black background) or heavily boxed.
layout_hierarchy.details: LOTE (Mono font), CONSERVAÇÃO, DESTINO, RESPONSÁVEL. Stacked tightly.
layout_hierarchy.footer: ALÉRGICOS. Inverted banner at the bottom.

components.name: LivePreviewCard
components.description: A sticky container on the right side of the screen that strictly renders the HTML/CSS exactly as it will print, simulating the 80mm paper size using aspect ratios.
components.instructions_to_main_agent: Wrap this in a div that represents the physical paper. Use aspect-ratio and exact mm mapping in CSS or scaled down px values. Ensure background is pure white.

components.name: LabelForm
components.description: Data entry form utilizing Shadcn Select and Input components for selecting product, destination, responsible, and quantity.
components.instructions_to_main_agent: Use dense spacing. Labels should be uppercase, tracking-wide. Add a 'Tamanho da Etiqueta' selector (80x40, 80x50, 80x60).

components.name: PrintQueueTable
components.description: A dense data table showing the current batch of labels waiting to be printed.
components.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn Table. Include columns for Product, Qty, Destino, and an action column to remove items.

accessibility.contrast: APCA high contrast compliant. Black on white for everything critical.
accessibility.testing_attributes: Add data-testid to all form inputs, buttons (e.g., data-testid='add-to-queue-button', data-testid='print-batch-button').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for the web interface and 'Barlow' / 'IBM Plex Mono' for the printed label.
Create a dedicated print stylesheet or use Tailwind's print modifier (print:hidden, print:block, etc).
The label DOM elements must use pure inline styles or strict Tailwind utility classes that enforce pure black and white (e.g., text-black, bg-white).
Implement the live preview by scaling down the exact DOM node that will be printed, or keeping it 1:1 if it fits on screen.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds in dropdowns.
Never use generic centered layouts for the app; use a strict grid structure.
Install and use 'lucide-react' for dashboard icons (e.g., printer, plus, trash, settings).
